newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest direct hogs seen flat-up $0.50-dealers.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest direct hogs seen flat-up $0.50-dealers.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hog prices Monday were seen steady to $0.50 per cwt higher, supported by firm pork prices late this week, livestock dealers said.
Pork prices were buoyed by tight supplies following three weeks of slaughter cutbacks by packers trying to mend operating margins, they said.
One packer buyer in the interior Iowa/southern Minnesota area said margins were off $4.00 per head instead of a nearly $9.00 loss per head last week.
Pork production this week was down 2.9 percent from a week ago and down 4.4 percent from the same week a year ago, USDA noted in its weekly red meat production report.
Interior Iowa/southern Minnesota top prices for hogs delivered to the plant could range $58.50 to $59.00 and Illinois top hog prices at the plant could range $58.00 to $58.50, the dealers said.
Indiana/Ohio top hog prices at the plant could range $58.50 to $59.00, they said.
